name: Speed Demon makes Suffuse grant 20% movement speed (#1223, #11578)
contract: Speed Demon 707232 reads 'Your Suffuse now increases your movement speed by 20%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). Suffuse 801063 is only the cast that triggers the heal-over-time 801064, whose effect index 2 is the native aura 31 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED) with amount 0. Speed Demon's raw effect is the native aura 107 SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (MiscValue 23, BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1) on class mask word1 32768, which only Suffuse 801063 and 801064 carry (#11578), so it raises 801064's own speed effect by 20 and Suffuse leaves a single buff. Suffuse is a Spender ability gated on Demonfire (500906) stacks; set_aura forces those stacks directly, matching Chop Shop's (#486) established pattern. Because a modifier change only recomputes passive auras, the scenario clears the untalented Suffuse application before recasting with Speed Demon known.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: baseline run speed is unmodified
Set Demonfire to the 6-stack cap so Suffuse is castable
SETUP: Suffuse landed without Speed Demon
BASELINE: Suffuse alone does not change movement speed
Force the Speed Demon passive aura
SETUP: the Speed Demon passive is active
Clear the untalented Suffuse application first: a refresh of the still-active aura from the first cast would not recompute EFFECT_2's amount, which is only calculated once at Aura creation
Clear the global cooldown from the first Suffuse cast
Let the fresh Suffuse application recompute its speed effect
SETUP: Suffuse is active with Speed Demon known
CONTRACT: movement speed rises by ~20% while Suffuse is active
